reason: Streaming expert-from-volume forward path runs (passes model load, fp4 dequant, expert GEMM, into the per-layer streaming loop) but does not complete even one prompt in practical time: each decode step re-reads 6 experts x 3 tensors x 43 layers from network-attached storage. The slow-but-correct baseline is the Phase 1 path by design; byte-budgeted expert caching (LBEF) is a later phase and deliberately absent (plan Step 8). 95% golden match additionally requires RoPE, the CSA indexer/compressor, and MTP layers, which are not implemented in this Phase 1 forward. Per plan §56/§62 the honest negative result is the Phase 1 deliverable.
